cohort: 65 term parturient (>=37 weeks gestation) with singleton pregnancy undergoing elective caesarean delivery, excluding those with multiple pregnancy or preexisting diseases like hypertension, preeclampsia, eclampsia, diabetes, cardiovascular, renal, hepatic or thyroid diseases.
finding: Higher variation in blood pressure and heart rate between supine/sitting and lateral positions was associated with a higher probability of post-spinal hypotension.
